name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Where Dragons Dwell
storyline:
he storyline focuses on the aftermath of the War of the Ring in the northern lands:

Dwarves Rebuild: The Longbeard descendants of Durin seek to restore their homes and secure their legacy after the devastation of war.
Threats in the North:

The Jangovar Easterlings menace the Ironfold.
Ancient dragons stir in the Grey Mountains, threatening the reclaimed strongholds.

Your Role:

Aid King Thorin’s brother Náin, Lord of the Iron Hills, in repelling invaders.
Explore lost dwarf kingdoms and uncover secrets hidden for ages.
Stand with Gandalf against Sauron’s lieutenants and beware the schemes of Karazgar, the Weeping Warrior.

Epic Themes: Chapters 7 and 8 of the Black Book of Mordor continue here, blending mystery, danger, and high-stakes battles against dragons and dark forces.
summary:
This quest pack unlocks adventures in the Dwarf-holds of the Grey Mountains, the Iron Hills, and Erebor. Key features include:

Regions:

Ered Mithrin and Withered Heath
Expanded halls beneath the Lonely Mountain

Content:

Over 120 quests and deeds for levels 115–120
Grey Mountains Instance Cluster: Caverns of Thrumfall, Glimmerdeep
Raid: The Anvil of Winterstith

LOTRO Store Info: Available for purchase or free for VIPs and Lifetime members.
